insights:
DeepSeek raised the price of DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 from $0.150 to $0.733 per 1M tokens, a 389% increase and the largest move on the board. The same vendor cut elsewhere: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash fell 52% from $0.057 to $0.027, DeepSeek Flash Latest dropped 50% to $0.041, and deepseek-r1 slipped 19% to $1.05. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash also left the intelligence frontier, and its max variant fell from #1 out of the top 10.

The steepest cut came from Z.ai, where GLM Latest dropped 74% from $2.03 to $0.519; GLM 5 fell 40% to $1.04 and GLM Flash Latest 8% to $0.085. Reflection's Beam 1.0 501B A23B fell 68% to $0.533, Qwen3.8 27B dropped 47% to $0.477 across all four reasoning settings, and Qwen3.5 397B A17B fell 32% to $1.04. Solar Pro 4 moved the other way, up 67% to $0.300.

New to the market: deepseek-v4.1-flash-max at $0.027, Inception's Mercury 3 at $0.183, and MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, which scored 43.0 intelligence with no price listed. Mercury 2.5 entered the intelligence frontier.
